notes.title: Input / controls update and playtests
notes.content:
We spent the last two weeks completely reworking our input system. This was something we pinpointed after analyzing your feedback from the demo survey - for which we're super grateful!

The input system now works with both mouse/keyboard and gamepad devices (which also means SteamDeck compatibility). We implemented a virtual mouse for gamepads, along with many quality-of-life features like arrow/WSAD camera movement, edge scrolling, and many others.



All these changes are now available to test via Steam Playtest.

Any feedback is much appreciated! 💛
